description:
Up to 3 alternative hotels for ONE night of a quoted Camino de
        Santiago package, of ANY accommodation category and as close as
        possible in price to the current one, each with the change in the
        package total (`variacion_total_eur`), room, meal plan and distance to
        the centre. Use it when the client wants a different hotel in a town —
        do NOT re-quote the whole trip. It checks live availability for that
        night, so it can find options even when the quote reported
        `alternativas_disponibles: 0` (takes a few seconds). Then apply the
        choice with swap_camino_hotel (`alternativa_id`). / Alternativas de
        cualquier categoría y de precio parecido para una noche; nunca
        precios por noche. (es: alternativas_alojamiento)
name: camino_hotel_alternatives
title: Alternative hotels for one night
